name: Microgrid operating-mode mismatch alarm
summary: Detects disagreement between the requested mode and the established topology or resource state.
description: Detects disagreement between the requested mode and the established topology or resource state. A microgrid operating-mode function coordinates how local sources and loads relate to the utility connection. The selected mode, the measured electrical condition and the actual switching configuration can differ during a transition.

In a microgrid serving a switchroom and industrial loads, the controller can move between grid-connected and islanded operating states only through its defined transition logic. Each state needs identifiable source roles and feedback. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Requested and observed modes” at the input and “Mode mismatch indication” at the output. The allowed transition interval must be defined.
